name: KrishiMitra
tagline: A smart farming advisor in the farmer's own language
problem: Crops chosen by habit, not by soil and season
Urea over-used, P and K neglected; money and soil wasted
Irrigation by guesswork; produce sold at the harvest-glut low
Advisory apps are English-first, online-only black boxes

stats.label: Indian farm holdings small/marginal (Agri Census 2015-16, approx.)
target N:P:K ratio; actual use is N-heavy (approx.)

solution: Soil test in, four decisions out: crop, fertiliser, water, sell
Two from-scratch ML models with per-input explanations
Full Tamil / English UI with read-aloud voice
Runs offline on one laptop; phones join over local Wi-Fi

features.title: Crop recommender
features.desc: Top-3 of 14 TN crops from Naive Bayes + Random Forest, with why-bars

features.title: Fertiliser advisor
features.desc: NPK deficit to Urea / DAP / MOP kg per acre, bags, organic options

features.title: Irrigation planner
features.desc: FAO-56 Ra + Hargreaves ET0 x Kc: 7-day plan in mm and litres/acre

features.title: Market timing
features.desc: Seasonal index + trend: sell now or hold N weeks, with price band

features.title: Crop calendar
features.desc: Visual timeline from land prep to harvest with key operations

features.title: Tamil + voice
features.desc: Every label and advice in Tamil script; speechSynthesis read-aloud

architecture: Browser UI -> vanilla JS, SVG charts, EN/TA, speech
app.py -> stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer, JSON API, validation
advisor -> one call runs every module for the chosen crop
recommender -> GNB + RF trained on seeded synthetic data
fertiliser / irrigation / market / calendar -> pure Python
algorithms: Gaussian Naive Bayes – crop probabilities + log-odds per input
CART + Random Forest – bootstrap, feature bagging, OOB, Saabas
FAO-56 Ra + Hargreaves ET0 – reference water demand
Kc stage curve + soil bucket – 7-day irrigation schedule
Ratio-to-moving-average seasonal index + OLS trend – sell/hold
innovation: One plan: crop choice drives dose, Kc, prices and calendar
Explainable ML written from scratch, two models side by side
Tamil-first advice text and voice, not just translated labels
Fully offline on a ₹15k laptop, ~3 ms per request

results.label: GNB and RF each, on the same hold-out

demo_flow: Open on phone + projector, Wi-Fi off
Tiruchengode farm: groundnut 99%, read the why-bars
Toggle Tamil and tap Read aloud
Fertiliser: 0 urea, 15 kg DAP, 29 kg MOP per acre
Delta paddy: irrigate once, 3.5 lakh L/acre
Market: sell now vs Erode turmeric hold
impact: Right-sized fertiliser cuts input cost and nitrate pollution
ET-based irrigation saves water and pumping power
Tamil voice advice reaches low-literacy and older farmers
Better sell timing on storable crops (illustrative)
business: B2G: explain-your-Soil-Health-Card layer for KVKs / state
B2B: white-label advisories for FPOs and input dealers
Freemium: free app, paid SMS/IVR voice advisories
Consented, anonymised data for agronomic research
future: Train on real Soil Health Card + yield data
Live IMD weather and Agmarknet prices, cached offline
More Indian languages and voice input
Pest and disease alerts from weather
Android PWA and SMS/IVR for feature phones
